answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. To earn rewards, an agent needs trades with 8 distinct counterparties across 4 clusters; parties sharing a wallet count as one. Each trade is logged like a pearl: real saffron deals leave a trail. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 8,000 counterparties at $56 each — $56,000 total, zero extra reward. An honest agent pays $56 once, keeps its full share, never diluted by fakes stranded in the tundra.
